name: @onecore/keycloak-bankid-provider
description: Mimer BankID identity provider for Keycloak (Java, built with Maven in Docker)

scripts.build: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/src -v keycloak-bankid-provider-m2:/root/.m2 -w /src maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21 mvn -B -q package -DskipTests
scripts.test: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/src -v keycloak-bankid-provider-m2:/root/.m2 -w /src maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21 mvn -B test
scripts.lint: echo 'Java: no linter, the compiler in build covers it'
scripts.typecheck: echo 'Java: types are checked by the compiler in build'
